purpose: isolated source art and machine-readable implementation intent for the SPELLCHECK R3F open-zone vertical slice
game_invariant: Explore through movement. Act through language. Exploration and casting inputs never compete.

open_decisions.waybinder_age: Current source image reads as an older teen or young adult. Do not regenerate as a literal child without an explicit canon decision.

default_texture_policy.4K: archival source only unless measured gameplay framing proves visible benefit

conversion_strategies.tripo_direct_candidate: generate a first-pass model, then validate, retopologize, normalize, and test
conversion_strategies.tripo_shell_then_rebuild: use generated form as a visual shell and explicitly rebuild or separate gameplay-critical parts
conversion_strategies.procedural_or_modular_rebuild: treat the image as art direction and construct deterministic reusable geometry
conversion_strategies.procedural_vfx_reference: implement motion and appearance with R3F particles, ribbons, decals, shaders, geometry, and light
conversion_strategies.direction_only: planning/reference image, not a single runtime mesh

assets.role: on-foot player identity, exploration locomotion, and casting origin
assets.notes: Generated without the grimoire. Keep hands, coat tails, and belt clear. Support walking and interaction; deploy the grimoire and field lectern only when casting begins.

assets.role: typed casting instrument
assets.notes: Decorative key glyphs are texture/ornament only. Runtime phrases and character feedback must remain separate text.

assets.role: embodied narration, timing, and roast delivery
assets.notes: Prefer independently controllable face plate, eye emissive, quill, arms, lute, and tail. Floating form removes foot-contact requirements.

assets.role: regional save hub, spellbook station, settings location, and transport between unlocked open zones
assets.notes: Treat the generated body as a shell. Dock it at waymarks; define explicit legs, docking transforms, interaction point, bard perch, cooldown mounts, and collider. Do not make the player steer it through the zone.

assets.role: diegetic phrase display
assets.notes: Tile faces stay blank. Render all phrase text, progress, errors, recommendation lock, and cooldown communication separately in R3F.

assets.role: fast basic threat
assets.notes: Use a coherent base mesh. Add live ink wobble, droplets, anticipation, and pop defeat procedurally rather than baking them into topology.

assets.role: slow armored threat that pressures recommendation changes
assets.notes: Pilot asset. Separate halo plates and chest core so they can rotate, dim, and express cooldown state independently.

assets.role: signature non-hostile typo consequence
assets.notes: Pilot asset. Preserve an ordinary silhouette and mildly disappointed expression. Generate the tiny charm separately if the cord fuses or becomes noisy.

assets.role: fast pressure and phrase-obscuring threat
assets.notes: Keep censor bands as solid armor or runtime ribbons. Loose torn edges may require simplification before rigging.

assets.role: paired or deceptive phrase threat
assets.notes: Two heads must remain separated. Reduce wing spread for production rigging if reconstruction fuses feathers or occludes the torso.

assets.role: long-form elite or boss
assets.notes: Generate or model head, one reusable body segment, and tail separately. Assemble along a spline; do not rely on a single long generated rig.

assets.role: visible destination landmark
assets.notes: Background silhouette matters more than close detail. Use primitive collision and separate only large reusable ruin pieces if useful.

assets.role: primary travel and encounter lane
assets.notes: Rebuild to exact dimensions and snap grid. Use generated appearance as the material and edge-breakup target.

assets.role: continuous route variation
assets.notes: Normalize both connection ends to the same width and elevation as the straight route.

assets.role: gap crossing and environmental obstacle frame
assets.notes: Guarantee Scriptorium clearance, route snap points, and a simplified deck collider after generation.

assets.role: repeatable verge and bounded-world edge
assets.notes: Build one or two deterministic variants and instance them; avoid unique generated geometry for every edge.

assets.role: reusable landmark and route-choice anchor
assets.notes: Create two material or damage variants from one accepted mesh; instance at runtime.

assets.role: world hazard, landmark, and spell-reaction surface
assets.notes: Use reusable bank geometry and a separate simple liquid plane. Ice should replace or overlay the surface deterministically.

assets.role: fire source, travel, and impact shape language
assets.notes: Implement broad amber-red arc, compact core, and bounded sparks; combine with wind by carrying fire particles along wind ribbons.

assets.role: ice source, travel, and impact shape language
assets.notes: Implement a forming cyan-white sheet and few large shards; keep the active typing prompt unobscured.

assets.role: wind source, travel, and impact shape language
assets.notes: Implement two pale-teal spiral ribbons and a few displaced particles; drive cloth and vegetation response separately.

assets.role: earth source, travel, and impact shape language
assets.notes: Implement rising blocks, one broad crack, and bounded fragments; persistent geometry comes from the earth barrier asset.

assets.role: temporary fire world memory
assets.notes: A projected decal over the existing route may be cheaper and align better than a replacement mesh.

assets.role: persistent ice world memory and obstacle
assets.notes: Use one coherent ridge and a primitive collider. Growth and melt are runtime behavior, not separate meshes.

assets.role: instanced vegetation and wind world memory
assets.notes: Build a very low-cost instanceable clump; bend direction is driven by world wind, not frozen into every instance.

assets.role: persistent earth world memory and repaired route
assets.notes: Keep the four slab silhouette; expose a simple collider and deterministic ground alignment.

assets.role: shared PBR and palette reference
assets.notes: Use to keep independently generated assets coherent. Do not upload the six-tile board as one model.

assets.role: world compilation and authored-route reference
assets.notes: Interpret through WORLD_LAYOUT_SPEC.json and OPEN_ZONE_SPEC.json. Preserve route readability, encounter clearings, reaction zones, optional side paths, and visible destination.

assets.role: first friendly NPC and interaction tutorial
assets.notes: Keep the map satchel and waymark token separable if they interfere with arm motion. Interaction uses proximity plus Enter or Space, never mouse clicking.

assets.role: regional hub anchor, save point, and travel return point
assets.notes: Normalize the platform and steps for walkability. Match the four docking brackets to authored Scriptorium foot transforms rather than trusting generated alignment.

assets.role: physical bridge between exploration and casting contexts
assets.notes: Mount the existing separate grimoire in the blank cradle at runtime. The lectern must finish deploying before printable keys are captured.

assets.role: environmental typing interaction outside combat
assets.notes: All five tile faces remain blank. Render the requested word at runtime and use the same context-safe typing capture as combat without spawning an enemy.

assets.role: walkable exploration clearing for NPCs, discoveries, and encounters
assets.notes: Rebuild to exact collision-safe dimensions. Preserve an uncluttered center and one route-width connector; scatter dressing separately.

assets.role: smooth elevation change without adding a jump mechanic
assets.notes: Use a simple ramp collider and match route connection width. Protect follow-camera sightlines at both elevations.

assets.role: subtle visual acknowledgement that movement has yielded to typing
assets.notes: Form in under 0.4 seconds after movement reaches zero. Keep the center and prompt sightline calm; fade after resolution without implying a separate action-game arena.
